73600e3d-aed5-4bed-97bf-fe50b1f3f659.Text: This {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} costs 50 {g|Encyclopedia:MomentumWithDetailsGlossary}momentum{/g} and can only be used when momentum is 175 or higher. Until the end of combat, the weapon in the psyker's hand is replaced by a sword made of sheer will. -This sword has a single-target attack and an {g|Encyclopedia:AreaOfEffect}area attack{/g} (like a two-handed sword) and can be used to release a cone of fire or a line of fire (like a flamer). -The damage of this sword gains the same bonuses as {g|f:4b401c668e0d46a7a09dba9d5480cdaa}Purge Soul{/g}. -If the psyker was using a force weapon, all the bonuses from that force weapon remain. For the purposes of {g|Encyclopedia:Talent}talents{/g} and other bonuses, the Sword of Faith counts as a force weapon. -This power can be used again, increasing the damage of the sword by +{uip|Resolve|20d5376f942f454daf37f2b81a81e7b1}.

00efac33-66fe-4b86-a117-8212f1b68956.Text: Gains the same {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} bonues as the {g|f:4b401c668e0d46a7a09dba9d5480cdaa}Purge Soul{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} to every enemy in front of the psyker.

0e0f4bf1-942e-4245-9a8a-b017828cc883.Text: A single-target {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttacksGlossary}melee{/g} strike that gains the same {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} bonuses as the {g|f:4b401c668e0d46a7a09dba9d5480cdaa}Purge Soul{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g}.

ba986531-0c72-4f0e-ad32-dbb29d486ac7.Text: Gains the same {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} bonuses as the {g|f:4b401c668e0d46a7a09dba9d5480cdaa}Purge Soul{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} to every enemy in a cone.

176c063f-ae3e-49d9-8866-eb9111201706.Text: Gains the same {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} bonuses as the {g|f:4b401c668e0d46a7a09dba9d5480cdaa}Purge Soul{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerPowersGlossary}psychic power{/g} to every enemy in a line.

6c626611-568f-4cc6-990a-93f9481e25cf.Text:
Deals (from {uip|MinDamage|4b401c668e0d46a7a09dba9d5480cdaa} to {uip|MaxDamage|4b401c668e0d46a7a09dba9d5480cdaa}) {g|Encyclopedia:DirectDamage}direct damage{/g} and pushes targets up to 8 tiles away.
This {g|Encyclopedia:DamageGlossary}damage{/g} is increased by +50% against xenos, by +100% against Chaos worshippers or Drukhari, by +150% against daemons, and by +50% if the enemy has already damaged the psyker or any of the psyker's allies this combat. These damage {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonuses{/g} also affect any damage bonuses from other sources.
! This power does not affect targets that lack souls.
